routes.name: Fastest Route
reasons: Direct arterial corridor spanning 10.4 km with composite safety score of 49.9 RSS. Accident score: 92.5/100, Lighting score: 20.0/100.

Temporal modifier of -13.0 pts results in a final 49.9 RSS.
